task_pack: 25 scenarios x 3 repetitions (23 pre-#227 scenarios re-scored separately)
notes: The three 2026-08-05 models (qwen3:1.7b, qwen3:8b, qwen3-coder:30b) were re-measured here on the current revision; files are suffixed -v2
ollama memory limit raised from 10Gi to 100Gi and CPU to 31 cores: the 30B models OOMKill at 10Gi and the symptom presents as connection errors
Spot eviction destroyed one qwen3:30b run and contaminated a devstral run; both re-run and only the clean results are included
A 3-way parallel run was attempted and abandoned: throughput was 2.5x WORSE than sequential (memory-bandwidth contention), despite CPU rising from 15.8 to 28 cores
Wall times are sequential-run measurements and are comparable with each other
